issues.description: The solution repository's Person entity declares the field 'forename' but the getters/setters and equals/hashCode still reference 'firstName'. The template (and tests) expect a field named 'firstName' (with getFirstName()/setFirstName()). This name mismatch will cause compilation errors in the solution code and is inconsistent with the template/tests, which will confuse students when they compare template, tests, and solution or try to run the provided solution code.
issues.suggested_fix: Rename the field in the solution's Person entity from 'forename' back to 'firstName' so that it matches the getters/setters and the template/tests. Alternatively, update all getters/setters, equals/hashCode, and tests consistently to use 'forename' instead of 'firstName'. Prefer restoring 'firstName' to align with the template and test code.

issues.description: The Person entity uses different identifiers for the same concept of a person's given name across artifacts. In the template (and in tests) the attribute is named "firstName" (and tests call setFirstName()/getFirstName()), whereas in the solution Person.java the backing field was renamed to "forename" while the getters/setters still reference "firstName". This creates a direct mismatch between field and accessor names in the solution and breaks the clear mapping students expect from template → tests → solution (and will likely cause compilation/test errors). Students reading the problem and template expect and use firstName; encountering "forename" in the solution is an unintended naming inconsistency that increases extraneous cognitive load and may mislead students about the correct attribute name to use.
issues.suggested_fix: Unify the identifier for the person's given name. The simplest fix is to rename the solution's field 'forename' back to 'firstName' in src/main/java/de/tum/in/ase/eist/model/Person.java so it matches the template, tests, and accessor methods. Alternatively, if 'forename' is preferred, update all getters/setters and all test/template usages to consistently use 'forename' (and adjust JSON/serialization names if necessary). Prefer keeping 'firstName' to minimize changes to tests and template.
